title: Raccoon dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='91' rx='30' ry='5' fill='#2a1a3a'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M72 70 Q88 68 86 54 Q84 42 76 38' stroke='#8a9ab8' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M82 58 Q84 52 80 48' stroke='#3a4a6a' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M84 44 Q82 40 78 40' stroke='#3a4a6a' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- left leg -->
  <path d='M38 78 Q32 86 28 92' stroke='#8a9ab8' stroke-width='8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='93' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#3a4a6a'/>
  <!-- right leg -->
  <path d='M58 78 Q64 84 68 90' stroke='#8a9ab8' stroke-width='8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='92' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#3a4a6a'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='65' rx='22' ry='20' fill='#8a9ab8'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='14' ry='12' fill='#b8c6de'/>
  <!-- left arm waving up -->
  <path d='M32 58 Q20 48 18 36' stroke='#8a9ab8' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='17' cy='33' r='5' fill='#3a4a6a'/>
  <!-- right arm out -->
  <path d='M68 58 Q80 56 86 48' stroke='#8a9ab8' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='89' cy='45' r='5' fill='#3a4a6a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='20' ry='17' fill='#8a9ab8'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='22' r='7' fill='#8a9ab8'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='22' r='4' fill='#c9a0a8'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='22' r='7' fill='#8a9ab8'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='22' r='4' fill='#c9a0a8'/>
  <!-- mask band -->
  <path d='M30 34 Q50 28 70 34 Q50 40 30 34Z' fill='#3a4a6a'/>
  <!-- eye patches -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='35' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#2a1a3a'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='35' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#2a1a3a'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='35' r='3' fill='#e0e8ff'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='35' r='3' fill='#e0e8ff'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='34.5' r='1.2' fill='#2a1a3a'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='34.5' r='1.2' fill='#2a1a3a'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#e0e8ff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#2a1a3a'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 46 Q50 50 55 46' stroke='#3a4a6a' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- highlights / motion marks -->
  <circle cx='14' cy='20' r='2' fill='#ffe680'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='14' r='1.5' fill='#ffe680'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='30' r='2' fill='#ffe680'/>
  <line x1='8' y1='28' x2='12' y2='28' stroke='#ffe680' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
